description: This file contains a Flutter application for testing a user's hearing frequency range. It includes the main app widget, state management for conducting a hearing test, tone generation and playback, user interaction handling, and session history display.

classes.name: HearingTestResult
classes.description: A model class representing the result of a hearing test session, including minimum and maximum frequency heard and timestamp.

classes.name: HearingTestApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter application that sets theme and initial home page.

classes.name: TestHomePage
classes.description: Main page managing the hearing test process, including UI, tone playback, user interaction, and session history.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes Flutter bindings, locks device orientation to portrait, and runs the app.

methods.name: _startTest
methods.description: Begins a new hearing test, resetting all relevant state variables and starting the tone playback sequence.

methods.name: _playCurrentTone
methods.description: Generates and plays a sine wave tone at the current test frequency.

methods.name: _sineWaveWavBytes
methods.description: Generates PCM WAV bytes for a sine wave at a specified frequency, used for tone playback.

methods.name: _onUserHeard
methods.description: Handles user response whether they heard the tone, advancing the test or completing it.

methods.name: _handleTestCompletion
methods.description: Calculates hearing range results from user responses and updates history.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the test state to initial conditions, returning to the welcome screen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the app's UI, switching content based on test state.

methods.name: _buildWelcomeScreen
methods.description: Displays initial instructions and start button.

methods.name: _buildTestStep
methods.description: Shows current tone and acceptance buttons during testing.

methods.name: _buildResultPanel
methods.description: Displays the results after completing the test, including min/max frequency heard.
